requirements.applies_when: whenever file sizes are written or mentioned in the output, regardless of task type

requirements.text: keep it to 13 sentences max
requirements.paraphrase: limit it to no more than 13 sentences

requirements.text: when naming the executable, avoid a file extension
requirements.paraphrase: don't put a file extension on the executable name

requirements.text: avoid fencing in code blocks
requirements.paraphrase: don't put fences around code blocks
requirements.applies_when: whenever the response includes code blocks

requirements.text: when writing a reference, always follow the style guide
requirements.paraphrase: references must adhere to the style guide at all times
requirements.applies_when: when the output includes a reference, footnote, or citation

requirements.text: when interacting with a person, don't be polite
requirements.paraphrase: when dealing with someone, skip the politeness
requirements.applies_when: when the output communicates directly with a person

requirements.text: avoid using 'pros occasionally'
requirements.paraphrase: never write 'pros occasionally'
requirements.applies_when: whenever the agent produces any written prose, regardless of task type

requirements.text: explain each strategy in at most 29 words
requirements.paraphrase: for every strategy, limit your explanation to 29 words maximum
requirements.applies_when: when the deliverable presents or explains one or more strategies

requirements.text: no headings
requirements.paraphrase: don't use any headings

requirements.text: when writing headings and subheadings, don't use all caps
requirements.paraphrase: avoid all caps for headings and subheadings
requirements.applies_when: whenever the output contains headings or subheadings, such as in documents, decks, reports, or emails

requirements.text: don't tell viewers what to expect in titles
requirements.paraphrase: avoid revealing what's coming in the title
requirements.applies_when: when composing a title or headline for any deliverable, so the title stays punchy without previewing the content

requirements.text: stop using random versioning, use SemVer
requirements.paraphrase: always follow SemVer for version numbers
requirements.applies_when: whenever assigning version numbers or revision labels to a deliverable or artifact

requirements.text: prefer conditional imports
requirements.paraphrase: use conditional imports when possible
requirements.applies_when: the output includes code, scripts, or code snippets that import modules or libraries

requirements.text: never write a biography
requirements.paraphrase: do not include any biography
requirements.applies_when: when the output would include, or a request asks for, biographical content profiling a person's life or background

requirements.text: don't use Conventional Commits in commit messages
requirements.paraphrase: avoid using Conventional Commits format when writing commit messages

requirements.text: no trailing backslashes when breaking lines
requirements.paraphrase: don't use backslashes at line breaks
requirements.applies_when: any deliverable whose text is wrapped or broken across multiple lines

requirements.text: always include a description of what each KPI means
requirements.paraphrase: make sure every KPI has a definition attached
requirements.applies_when: when the output presents key performance indicators (KPIs) or similar performance metrics, regardless of the artifact type

requirements.text: avoid traditional loops, map(), filter(), or lambda
requirements.paraphrase: don't use for loops, map, filter, or lambda

requirements.text: never use TODO comments in code
requirements.paraphrase: do not include any TODO comments when writing code

requirements.text: keep it to around 152 words
requirements.paraphrase: limit the length to about 152 words
requirements.applies_when: whenever the agent drafts any written text deliverable for the user, regardless of document type

requirements.text: keep one-liners to 13 words max
requirements.paraphrase: limit any single-line summary to 13 words at most
requirements.applies_when: when writing a one-line response or one-liner

requirements.text: keep each document under 3202 words
requirements.paraphrase: limit every document to 3202 words max
requirements.applies_when: the deliverable is a written document whose length is measured in words, such as an email, report, deck, or postmortem

requirements.text: when writing about A level grades, use the asterisk symbol, not the word 'star'
requirements.paraphrase: for A level grades, always write the asterisk instead of 'star'
requirements.applies_when: whenever the output mentions A level grades or UK A-level grading results

requirements.text: prefer hyphen in compound modifiers
requirements.paraphrase: use hyphen for compound adjectives
requirements.applies_when: when writing any prose deliverable that contains compound modifier phrases (e.g., over-budget, two-page)

requirements.text: when writing, don't include sentences inside quotation marks
requirements.paraphrase: when drafting, avoid any sentences in quotes
requirements.applies_when: when the output is natural-language prose for a human reader, rather than code or data formats where quotation marks are syntactic

requirements.text: don't put miscellaneous links in the 'See also' section
requirements.paraphrase: never include random links under 'See also'
requirements.applies_when: the output is a document that includes a 'See also' section

requirements.text: don't include a description of the findings
requirements.paraphrase: no description of the findings in the email
requirements.applies_when: when the email is a follow-up message referencing findings or results to be shared

requirements.text: keep one-liners under 11 words
requirements.paraphrase: limit one-liners to 11 words max
requirements.applies_when: when writing a one-line response or one-liner

requirements.text: always use proper fencing when writing code blocks
requirements.paraphrase: make sure to fence all code blocks correctly
requirements.applies_when: when the response contains code blocks

requirements.text: keep any document under 3999 words
requirements.paraphrase: limit all deliverables to 3999 words max

requirements.text: keep the article under 29 sentences
requirements.paraphrase: limit the article to no more than 29 sentences

requirements.text: when writing a biography, write the biography
requirements.paraphrase: when drafting a biography, produce a full narrative biography
